Three retries and a 50ms media-time tolerance bound observed wrong-time events; seeked/currentTime do not guarantee drawable frame identity.
Real browser tests use a minimal host, not a core integration. Windows WebKit is not physical Safari.

failuresRetained.meaning: Previous checkpoint has no attached renderer; Windows WebKit recorded detached black cells. Other browsers also fail the new attachment requirement, not necessarily the same pixel defect.

Initial broad pixel experiment exposed transparent early draws and wrong-time events; pattern JPEG center assertions also incorrectly assumed all cells pure blue. Retained as diagnostic failure, never acceptance.
A later WebKit cell had currentTime about 1.6 seconds from target. Fixed by bounded time validation/retry before drawing, then new source/main/legacy runs.
